# Control Narrative: Boiler Feedwater Pumps (FWP)

**Basis:** Reverse-engineered from the extracted ST code only. No P&ID, instrument index, cause-and-effect chart or alarm database was supplied. Section 6 lists the interlocks and Section 7 the alarms. Items marked **as-found** describe what the code does. Items marked **confirm** are my proposals and need operations sign-off. The code has several defects that you should decide on before re-implementing them (Section 10, findings F-1 to F-7).

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

- FWP keeps feedwater header pressure by running one lead pump and starting one lag pump on demand.
- Pumps: P1 and P2, duty/duty. Lead and lag roles swap weekly.
- Upstream: feedwater supply (source not in the code). Downstream: the feedwater header at PT101 and the boiler drum at LT100.
- Out of scope: drum level control, pump motor protection, burner trips. The low-low drum level trip, if any, belongs in the SIS SRS (IEC 61511). It is not specified here.

## 2. Tags used

| Tag | Description | Units | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1, P2 | Feedwater pumps (Run command, Fault status) | – | Outputs and inputs |
| PT101 | FW header pressure | bar | Lag start and stop |
| LT100 | Drum level | % | Pump stop |
| LeadSel | Lead selector (1 = P1 lead, otherwise P2 lead) | – | Internal |
| Lead, Lag | Role aliases of P1 and P2 | – | Internal |
| AutoMode | Module auto mode | – | Permissive |
| LagTmr | Lag start on-delay timer | s | Internal |
| LagLatched | Lag-called flag | – | Internal |
| Maint_B7 | Maintenance bit | – | Input |
| LT100_Lo | Low-level flag | – | Internal, forced by Maint_B7 |

## 3. States and transitions

The code has no explicit states. These states are derived from its behavior. Mode: state-based control (SBC).

| State | Entry permissive | Initiator | Allowed exits | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S0 Not in auto | AutoMode false | Operator | S1 | Manual |
| S1 Lead running | AutoMode true, Lead not faulted, LT100 not below SP-004 | Auto | S2, S3, S0 | Automatic |
| S2 Lead and lag running | LagLatched set by T1 or T2 | Auto | S1 (T3), S3 | Automatic |
| S3 Low-level stop | LT100 below SP-004 | Auto | S1 when LT100 recovers (as-found: no hysteresis) | Automatic |

| ID | Transition | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | S1 to S2 | PT101 below SP-001 for SP-003 |
| T2 | S1 to S2 | Lead.Fault true |
| T3 | S2 to S1 | PT101 above SP-002 and LagLatched set |
| T4 | any to S3 | LT100 below SP-004 |

## 4. Regulatory control

None. FWP is on/off staging only. No PID loop and no pump speed control appear in the code.

## 5. Sequences

No step sequence exists. The only timed action is the lag start delay.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Start LagTmr when PT101 is below SP-001 | Timer elapsed (SP-003) | SP-003 | Timer resets if PT101 is not below SP-001 |
| 2 | Start Lag, set LagLatched | Lag.Run true | None in code. **Confirm:** alarm if no run feedback after SP-009 | Alarm, see Section 7 |

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

| Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|
| LT100 below SP-004 | Stop P1 and P2. Overrides all start commands | Auto-reset (as-found) | LT100 rises to SP-004 or above |
| PT101 above SP-002 and LagLatched set | Stop Lag | Auto-reset | New lag start demand |
| Lead.Fault true | Start Lag | Sealed in by LagLatched | Lag stop (PT101 above SP-002) |
| AutoMode false or Lead.Fault true | Block Lead start command | Auto-reset | Condition clears |

## 7. Alarms

The code raises no alarms. The module needs these (names provisional, **confirm** against the alarm database):

| Alarm | Response |
|---|---|
| FWP low drum level stop active | Operator checks the level source and the drum |
| FWP lead pump fault | Operator checks Lead pump. Lag has started |
| FWP lag called | Information. Operator checks cause of low pressure |
| FWP lag no run feedback | Operator checks Lag pump |
| PT101 or LT100 bad quality | See Section 8 |

## 8. Abnormal handling

The code does not handle these cases. All values below are proposals (**confirm**).

| Event | Required behavior |
|---|---|
| PT101 bad | Start Lag. Alarm. Operator decides on stop |
| LT100 bad | Hold current pump state. Alarm. Do not trip on a bad signal |
| Comms loss to a pump | Treat as pump fault. Start the other pump |
| Power loss and restart | Clear LagTmr and LagLatched. Lead restarts when AutoMode is true. Lag restarts by normal demand |
| Output fail position | Pump Run de-energized means pump stopped |

## 9. Operator interface

- The operator sees: lead and lag roles, run and fault status of P1 and P2, PT101, LT100, LagLatched, low-level stop active.
- The operator changes: AutoMode, LeadSel (manual swap), Maint_B7 (maintenance access).
- The operator gets prompts for: pump faults, low-level stop, lag called. Operations must sign off on all states and prompts.

## 10. Requirements, setpoints, findings, open items

### Setpoint list

| ID | Value | Units | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| SP-001 | 18.5 | bar | As-found |
| SP-002 | 21.0 | bar | As-found |
| SP-003 | 8 | s | As-found |
| SP-004 | 15.0 | % | As-found |
| SP-005 | 1 | DayOfWeek | As-found, confirm day numbering |
| SP-006 | 6 | h | As-found |
| SP-007 | 0 | min | As-found |
| SP-008 | 30 | s | Provisional, confirm (swap overlap) |
| SP-009 | 10 | s | Provisional, confirm (lag run feedback) |
| SP-010 | 1.0 | % | Provisional, confirm (low-level restart hysteresis) |

### Requirements (as-found behavior)

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-FWP-001 | When LeadSel is 1, P1 is Lead and P2 is Lag. Otherwise P2 is Lead and P1 is Lag. | Set LeadSel both ways. Check roles. |
| FR-FWP-002 | When AutoMode is true and Lead.Fault is false, command Lead to run. | Simulate. Check Lead.Run. |
| FR-FWP-003 | When PT101 stays below SP-001 for SP-003, command Lag to run and set LagLatched. | Force PT101 low. Time the start. |
| FR-FWP-004 | If PT101 rises to SP-001 or above before SP-003 elapses, reset the timer. | Force PT101 low, then high before the timer ends. |
| FR-FWP-005 | When Lead.Fault is true, command Lag to run at once and set LagLatched. | Force Lead.Fault. |
| FR-FWP-006 | When PT101 is above SP-002 and LagLatched is set, stop Lag. | Raise PT101 above SP-002. |
| FR-FWP-007 | Lag keeps running between SP-001 and SP-002 after it starts. | Hold PT101 in the band. Check Lag.Run. |
| FR-FWP-008 | When LT100 is below SP-004, command P1 and P2 to stop. This overrides FR-FWP-002, -003, -005. | Force LT100 low with both pumps running. |
| FR-FWP-009 | While Maint_B7 is true, force LT100_Lo to false. This does not change pump commands. | Set Maint_B7. Check LT100_Lo and pumps. |
| FR-FWP-010 | At SP-005, SP-006 and SP-007, swap LeadSel. | See F-1. |

### Findings in the as-found code

| ID | Location | Issue | Proposed fix (confirm) |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-1 | Weekly swap | No one-shot. The swap runs on every scan during the minute, so the final LeadSel depends on scan count (odd or even). | FR-FWP-011: swap once, on the rising edge of the time match. Test: check one toggle per week. |
| F-2 | Weekly swap | Old Lead.Run is never cleared. After the swap both pumps can keep running. | FR-FWP-012: start new Lead, then stop old Lead after SP-008 with run feedback. |
| F-3 | Low-level stop | No latch, no delay, no hysteresis. Pumps restart on the first scan above SP-004, which can chatter. | FR-FWP-013: restart only when LT100 is above SP-004 plus SP-010. |
| F-4 | Low-level stop | Stopping feed pumps on low drum level is unusual. Low level normally needs more feed. LT100 may be a deaerator level, or the comment may be wrong. | Process engineer confirms intent. Move any boiler protection to the SRS. |
| F-5 | Lag stop, last-write-wins | With Lead.Fault true and PT101 above SP-002, Lag stops. It restarts when PT101 falls to SP-002 or below. | FR-FWP-014: keep Lag running while Lead.Fault is true. |
| F-6 | Lag and Lead logic | Lag start ignores AutoMode and Lag.Fault. Nothing stops Lead when AutoMode goes false. LagLatched is never cleared. | FR-FWP-015: block Lag start when Lag.Fault is true. Clear LagLatched at Lag stop. Operator owns manual stop. |
| F-7 | Maint_B7 | LT100_Lo is not used in this extract. Its effect elsewhere is unknown. | Search the full program for LT100_Lo. |

Each proposed fix is a requirement only after operations accepts it. Until then, FR-FWP-001 to -010 stand as-found, defects included.
